question: My laptop is ________; I think it has a virus.
solution: Act up का अर्थ है 'मशीन या शरीर के अंग का ठीक से काम न करना' (malfunction)।

question: The scammer tried to ________ the elderly lady ________ her life savings.
solution: Cheat out of का अर्थ है 'धोखे से किसी चीज़ से वंचित कर देना' (to deprive someone through deception)।

question: I need to ________ my French before I travel to Paris next month.
solution: Brush up का अर्थ है 'पुराने ज्ञान या कौशल को सुधारना या दोहराना' (improve/refresh knowledge)।

question: Just ________ the items on the list as you buy them.
solution: Cross off का अर्थ है 'सूची से नाम काटना या हटाना' (remove from a list)。

question: The hikers decided to ________ in the woods for the night.
solution: Camp out का अर्थ है 'तंबू में या घर के बाहर सोना/रहना' (sleep outdoors in a tent)।

question: Guess who I ________ at the grocery store today? Our old school teacher!
solution: Bump into का अर्थ है 'अचानक मिलना या टकरा जाना' (meet by chance)।

question: This luxury hotel aims to ________ the needs of high-profile international guests.
solution: Cater to का अर्थ है 'ज़रूरतें या इच्छाएं पूरी करना' (to provide what someone wants)।

question: The old book was so fragile that it started to ________ in my hands.
solution: Come apart का अर्थ है 'टुकड़े-टुकड़े होकर टूट जाना' (to break into pieces)।

question: Seeing the angry dog, the children slowly ________.
solution: Back away का अर्थ है 'डर के कारण पीछे हटना' (move backwards from something)।

question: You need to ________ successfuly with the stress of your new job.
solution: Cope with का अर्थ है 'कठिन स्थिति का सफलतापूर्वक सामना करना' (to deal with challenge)। Silly Mistake Alert: 'Cope up with' जैसा कोई शब्द नहीं होता, केवल 'Cope with' होता है।

question: I need to ________ with this essay if I want to finish it by midnight.
solution: Crack on का अर्थ है 'किसी काम को तेज़ी से जारी रखना' (to continue quickly with a task)。

question: The crisis ________ all the courage and strength he had.
solution: Call forth का अर्थ है 'किसी गुण या भावना का आह्वान करना या उसे जगाना' (evoke/summon into action)।

question: Unexpected problems always seem to ________ at the worst possible time.
solution: Crop up का अर्थ है 'अचानक या अप्रत्याशित रूप से सामने आना' (appear unexpectedly)。

question: After a long winter, the sun finally ________ from behind the thick clouds.
solution: Break forth का अर्थ है 'अचानक प्रकट होना' (suddenly emerge)। सूर्य का बादलों से निकलना 'Break forth' कहलाता है।

question: Before the storm arrived, people ________ all the bread and milk in the shops.
solution: Buy up का अर्थ है 'सारा माल या स्टॉक खरीद लेना' (buy all available stock)।

question: The company had to ________ an IT expert to fix the server issue.
solution: Call in का अर्थ है 'किसी विशेषज्ञ या मदद को बुलाना' (summon an expert)।

question: The company didn't make any profit this year, but at least it ________.
solution: Break even का अर्थ है 'न लाभ न हानि की स्थिति होना' (no profit or loss)।

question: The teacher tried to ________ the student ________ by asking a very tricky question.
solution: Catch out का अर्थ है 'किसी की गलती या झूठ को पकड़ लेना' (to discover someone's mistake/deception)।

question: He wanted to go bungee jumping, but he ________ at the last minute.
solution: Chicken out का अर्थ है 'डर के कारण पीछे हटना' (to withdraw due to fear)।

question: After years of research, the scientists finally ________ in their search for a cure.
solution: Break through का अर्थ है 'किसी बड़ी बाधा को पार करना या महत्वपूर्ण सफलता पाना' (overcome an obstacle)。

question: I don't ________ your decision to quit the job without having another one.
solution: Agree with का अर्थ है 'किसी व्यक्ति के विचार से सहमत होना' (have the same opinion)।

question: Every week, I try to ________ at my massive credit card debt.
solution: Chip away का अर्थ है 'धीरे-धीरे कम करना या नष्ट करना' (to gradually reduce or erode)।

question: The government is planning to ________ a new law to curb cybercrime.
solution: Bring in का अर्थ है 'नया कानून या व्यवस्था लागू करना' (introduce a law/system)।

question: The new manager tried to ________ his authority over the team.
solution: Build up का अर्थ है 'धीरे-धीरे विकास करना या बढ़ाना' (to increase gradually/develop)।

question: After being knocked out, it took him several minutes to ________.
solution: Come to का एक अर्थ है 'होश में आना' (to regain consciousness)। इसके अन्य अर्थ 'कुल योग होना' भी है।

question: Many small businesses had to ________ during the economic crisis.
solution: Close down का अर्थ है 'स्थायी रूप से बंद होना' (stop operating permanently)।

question: I'm going to have a party; can I ________ you ________?
solution: Count in का अर्थ है 'शामिल करना' (to include someone)。

question: Why don't you ________ your cousin ________ for dinner this Sunday?
solution: Bring over का अर्थ है 'किसी को अपने घर लाना' (bring someone to one's home)।

question: He tried to ________ the warning as a mere joke, but it was serious.
solution: Blow off का एक अर्थ 'किसी चीज़ को नज़रअंदाज़ करना या टालना' भी होता है (to ignore/skip)।

question: While hiking, we ________ a hidden waterfall in the forest.
solution: Come upon का अर्थ है 'अचानक मिलना या पाना' (to find or meet unexpectedly)।

question: The unused vacation days will ________ to the next year.
solution: Carry over का अर्थ है 'बची हुई चीज़ को आगे ले जाना' (transfer to the next period)।

question: I suspect that he is ________ his wife with a co-worker.
solution: Cheat on का अर्थ है 'रिश्ते में बेवफ़ाई करना' (to be unfaithful)।

question: Visiting my old school ________ many childhood memories.
solution: Bring back का अर्थ है 'पुरानी यादें ताज़ा करना' (revive memories)।

question: The bullies ________ the small boy behind the school building.
solution: Beat up का अर्थ है 'बुरी तरह पीटना' (attack and injure by hitting repeatedly)।

question: After 40 years of service, the CEO decided to ________ and enjoy his retirement.
solution: Bow out का अर्थ है 'शालीनता से किसी पद या काम से अलग हो जाना' (withdraw gracefully)।

question: The coastal residents were told to ________ the upcoming hurricane.
solution: Brace for का अर्थ है 'कठिनाई के लिए मानसिक या शारीरिक रूप से तैयार होना' (prepare for something difficult)।

question: The teacher was shocked when the student started to ________.
solution: Answer back का अर्थ है 'बदतमीजी या पलटकर जवाब देना' (reply rudely to authority)।

question: Despite being an underdog, the athlete managed to ________ a gold medal.
solution: Carry off का अर्थ है 'जीतना' या 'कठिन काम सफलतापूर्वक करना' (to win/succeed despite difficulty)।

question: His determination helped him ________ the difficult times.
solution: Carry through का अर्थ है 'किसी काम या स्थिति को अंत तक पूरा करना' (complete despite difficulties)।

question: She got ________ by the music and started dancing in the street.
solution: Carry away का अर्थ है 'भावनाओं में बह जाना या बहुत ज्यादा उत्साहित होना' (get overly excited)।

question: The police ________ the street after the major accident.
solution: Block off का अर्थ है 'रास्ता बंद करना या अवरुद्ध करना' (close or obstruct an area)।

question: Dark old houses always ________ me ________.
solution: Creep out का अर्थ है 'डरावना लगना या असहज महसूस कराना' (make someone feel uncomfortable/scared)。

question: How is your new project ________?
solution: Come along का अर्थ है 'प्रगति करना' (to make progress)। इसके अन्य अर्थ 'साथ आना' और 'आगमन' भी हैं।

question: This evidence does not ________ the current case.
solution: Bear on/upon का अर्थ है 'किसी चीज़ से संबंधित होना या उसे प्रभावित करना' (to be relevant to)।

question: After a long illness, he was finally able to ________ and return to work.
solution: Bounce back का अर्थ है 'मुसीबत या बीमारी के बाद जल्दी उबरना' (recover quickly from a setback)।

question: The coach was so angry that he ________ at the referee.
solution: Burst out का अर्थ है 'अचानक चिल्ला उठना या भावनाएं व्यक्त करना' (suddenly exclaim/start crying/laughing)।

question: If we all ________ ten dollars, we can buy a great gift for the teacher.
solution: Chip in का अर्थ है 'पैसों या मदद का योगदान देना' (to contribute money or help)।

question: The doctor used smelling salts to ________ the fainted man ________.
solution: Bring round (or around) का अर्थ है 'होश में लाना' (revive someone who fainted)।

question: The price of gold has ________ significantly this month.
solution: Come down का अर्थ है 'कीमत या स्तर का गिरना/कम होना'।

question: I am going to ________ a visa tomorrow at the embassy.
solution: Apply for का अर्थ है 'किसी चीज़ के लिए औपचारिक आवेदन करना' (formal request)।

question: Citizens must ________ the laws of the land to maintain order.
solution: Abide by का अर्थ है 'नियम का पालन करना'। यहाँ कानून (laws) के पालन की बात हो रही है।

question: It's not healthy to ________ your anger; you should talk about it.
solution: Bottle up का अर्थ है 'अपनी भावनाओं या गुस्से को दबाकर रखना' (suppress emotions)।

question: After being warned by the police, the crowd began to ________.
solution: Back off का अर्थ है 'दबाव या हस्तक्षेप बंद करके पीछे हटना' (retreat/stop pressuring)।

question: The soldiers managed to ________ the enemy's flags after the victory.
solution: Bear away का अर्थ है 'अपने साथ ले जाना' या 'जीतना' (to carry something away)।

question: When you come for the party, feel free to ________ a friend ________.
solution: Bring along का अर्थ है 'अपने साथ किसी को या किसी चीज़ को लाना'।

question: When you buy the car, the insurance cost is ________.
solution: Build in का अर्थ है 'किसी चीज़ को मुख्य हिस्से के रूप में शामिल करना' (include as an integral part)।

question: The burglars managed to ________ the entire house ________ while the family was away.
solution: Clean out का अर्थ है 'पूरा खाली कर देना या सब कुछ लूट लेना' (to empty completely/take all money)।

question: The large corporation decided to ________ its smaller competitor.
solution: Buy out का अर्थ है 'किसी का हिस्सा या पूरी कंपनी खरीद लेना' (purchase shares/business)।

question: What time do we need to ________ at the airport for our flight?
solution: Check in का अर्थ है 'हवाई अड्डे या होटल में पंजीकरण कराना'।

question: The police asked for witnesses of the crime to ________.
solution: Come forward का अर्थ है 'मदद या जानकारी के लिए स्वेच्छा से आगे आना'।

question: It took the firefighters several hours to ________ the fire ________.
solution: Bring under का अर्थ है 'नियंत्रण में लाना' (bring under control)। आग बुझाने या दंगे शांत करने के लिए इसका प्रयोग होता है।

question: He ________ more than he could chew by taking on three projects at once.
solution: Bite off का अर्थ है 'दांत से काटना'। यहाँ मुहावरा "Bite off more than one can chew" का प्रयोग है जिसका अर्थ है औकात से ज़्यादा काम लेना।

question: The accountant will ________ the remaining balance to the next month's sheet.
solution: Carry forward का अर्थ है 'शेष राशि को अगले समय/अवधि के लिए ले जाना' (transfer to the next period)।

question: Please ________ your room before the guests arrive.
solution: Brush up का यहाँ अर्थ है 'साफ-सुथरा करना या सजाना' (to tidy or smarten appearance)।

question: Spring ________ new life in the forest.
solution: Bring forth का अर्थ है 'उत्पन्न करना' (to produce)। बसंत नए जीवन को उत्पन्न करता है।

question: Please ________ your desk ________; it's a mess in here.
solution: Clear up का अर्थ है 'साफ-सफाई या व्यवस्थित करना' (to tidy)। इसके अन्य अर्थ 'सुलझाना' और 'मौसम साफ होना' भी हैं।

question: The gambler ________ the horse with the lowest odds.
solution: Bet on का अर्थ है 'दांव लगाना' या किसी चीज़ के होने पर भरोसा करना (to gamble/rely on)।

question: You shouldn't ________ his advice; he is an expert in this field.
solution: Brush aside का अर्थ है 'नज़रअंदाज़ करना या महत्व न देना' (to dismiss or ignore)।

question: Don't forget to ________ your travel insurance when calculating the budget.
solution: Add in का अर्थ है 'कुल योग में शामिल करना' (include as part of a total)।

question: After days of lying, he finally decided to ________ about the accident.
solution: Come clean का अर्थ है 'सच उगल देना या स्वीकार करना' (to confess the truth)।

question: The protesters refused to ________ until their demands were met.
solution: Back down का अर्थ है 'अपनी बात या स्थिति से पीछे हटना' (withdraw from a position/argument)।

question: I didn't think this new fashion trend would ________, but everyone is wearing it now.
solution: Catch on का अर्थ है 'लोकप्रिय होना' (to become popular)। इसका दूसरा अर्थ 'समझ आना' भी होता है।

question: High-intensity workouts ________ a lot of energy in a short period.
solution: Bring forth का अर्थ है 'उत्पन्न करना या पैदा करना' (to produce)।

question: It takes a few minutes for the operating system to ________.
solution: Boot up का अर्थ है 'कंप्यूटर चालू करना' (start a computer)।

question: You should ________ your stocks now while the market is high.
solution: Cash in का अर्थ है 'किसी स्थिति का फायदा उठाना या चीज़ को भुनाना' (profit or exchange for money)।

question: The military needs to ________ its defenses along the border.
solution: Beef up का अर्थ है 'मज़बूत करना या बढ़ाना' (to strengthen/increase something)।

question: The dishonest salesman ________ me ________ fifty dollars.
solution: Con out of का अर्थ है 'धोखे से कुछ हासिल करना' (to obtain through deception)।

question: This is a private conversation between us, so please ________!
solution: Butt out का अर्थ है 'दखल देना बंद करना' (stop interfering)। यह थोड़ा रूखा (rude) तरीका है।

question: The financial advisor ________ investing all the money in a single stock.
solution: Advise against का अर्थ है 'कुछ न करने की सलाह देना' (recommend not doing something)।

question: Grease and hair can easily ________ the bathroom drains.
solution: Clog up का अर्थ है 'अवरुद्ध या जाम हो जाना' (to block or become blocked)।

question: The cruel dictator decided to ________ anyone who spoke against his regime.
solution: Cast out का अर्थ है 'निकाल देना या निष्कासित करना' (to expel or drive out)।

question: My car started to ________ in the middle of the highway, so I had to call a mechanic.
solution: Act up का अर्थ है 'मशीन या शरीर के अंग का ठीक से काम न करना' (malfunction)।

question: I haven't seen him in years; I wonder what has ________ him.
solution: Become of का उपयोग यह पूछने के लिए किया जाता है कि किसी का 'क्या हुआ' (happen to someone)।

question: The failure of his project ________ him ________.
solution: Cast down का अर्थ है 'निराश या हतोत्साहित करना' (make someone feel sad/discouraged)।

question: The government decided to ________ on illegal street racing.
solution: Clamp down का अर्थ है 'सख्ती से दमन करना या कड़ाई करना' (take strict action to suppress)।

question: I strongly ________ the power of hard work and honesty.
solution: Believe in का अर्थ है 'किसी चीज़ के मूल्य या अस्तित्व में विश्वास रखना' (have faith/trust)।

question: I can ________ you to keep my secret, right?
solution: Count on का अर्थ है 'किसी पर भरोसा या निर्भर करना' (to rely on someone)。

question: The suspect couldn't ________ his whereabouts on the night of the crime.
solution: Account for का अर्थ है 'कारण बताना' या स्पष्टीकरण देना (to explain the reason)।

question: The new mayor promised to ________ the city's corrupt police force.
solution: Clean up का अर्थ है 'सुधार करना या भ्रष्टाचार हटाना'। इसके अन्य अर्थ 'साफ करना' और 'खूब मुनाफा कमाना' भी हैं।

question: He decided to ________ a story ________ for the children.
solution: Act out का अर्थ है 'अभिनय करना या नाटक के रूप में दिखाना' (perform a story with actions)।

question: We must ________ of the hotel before 11:00 AM to avoid extra charges.
solution: Check out का अर्थ है 'होटल छोड़ना'। इसके अन्य अर्थ 'जाँचना' और लाइब्रेरी से 'किताब लेना' भी होते हैं।

question: To solve this complex math problem, we should ________ the basic formulas.
solution: Begin with का अर्थ है 'किसी चीज़ से शुरुआत करना' (start with something)।

question: He is taking protein supplements to ________ his muscles.
solution: Bulk up का अर्थ है 'मांसपेशियां बढ़ाना या शरीर को भारी बनाना' (gain muscle mass)।

question: The small boutique is now ________ into jewelry and accessories.
solution: Branch out का अर्थ है 'नए क्षेत्रों में विस्तार करना' (expand into new areas)।

question: You will have to ________ your mistakes if the project fails.
solution: Answer for का अर्थ है 'किसी चीज़ के लिए जिम्मेदार या जवाबदेह होना' (to be accountable)।

question: As the deadline ________, the team began to work much faster.
solution: Close in का अर्थ है 'करीब आना या घेरना' (to approach threateningly or draw nearer)।

question: The charity’s work ________ many people who want to help the poor.
solution: Appeal to का अर्थ है 'किसी को आकर्षित करना' (to attract/interest someone)।

question: "I'm tired of your complaints, so ________!" he shouted at his brother.
solution: Buzz off का अर्थ है 'चले जाना या भाग जाना' (go away - usually rude)।

question: When she was criticized on social media, she didn't hesitate to ________.
solution: Clap back का अर्थ है 'आलोचना का तीखा या करारा जवाब देना' (respond sharply to criticism)।

question: When planning the trip, you must ________ the possibility of flight delays.
solution: Allow for का अर्थ है 'योजना बनाते समय किसी चीज़ को ध्यान में रखना' (consider when planning)।

question: The police ________ the area to investigate the suspicious package.
solution: Close off का अर्थ है 'किसी क्षेत्र में प्रवेश बंद करना' (to block access to an area)।

question: I cannot ________ this rainy weather; it makes me feel gloomy.
solution: Agree with का एक अर्थ 'किसी वातावरण या भोजन का शरीर को रास आना' (suit) भी होता है। यहाँ मौसम रास नहीं आ रहा।

question: Can you ________ for me while I go to the doctor's appointment?
solution: Cover for का अर्थ है 'किसी की अनुपस्थिति में उसकी जगह काम करना'।

question: The company’s new strategy ________ capturing the international market.
solution: Aim at का अर्थ है 'कोई लक्ष्य रखना' या इरादा करना (intend to achieve)।

question: I don't really ________ horror movies; I prefer comedies.
solution: Care for का अर्थ है 'पसंद करना' (to like something)। इसका दूसरा अर्थ 'देखभाल करना' भी होता है।

question: I'm busy right now; can I ________ you ________ in an hour?
solution: Call back का अर्थ है 'वापस फोन करना' (return a phone call)।

question: The prisoner managed to ________ the cell door and escape.
solution: Break open का अर्थ है 'बलपूर्वक या ज़बरदस्ती खोलना' (to open by force)।

question: The mother went upstairs to ________ her sleeping baby.
solution: Check on का अर्थ है 'हाल-चाल देखना या स्थिति की जाँच करना' (verify someone's condition)।

question: The former CEO was ________ fraud and money laundering.
solution: Charge with का अर्थ है 'किसी पर कानूनी रूप से आरोप लगाना' (to formally accuse of a crime)।

question: The government had to ________ the airline company to prevent its bankruptcy.
solution: Bail out का अर्थ है 'किसी को आर्थिक या अन्य मुश्किल से बचाना' (rescue from difficulty)।

question: His explanation for the missing money just doesn't ________.
solution: Add up का अर्थ है 'तर्कसंगत या सही प्रतीत होना' (to seem logical/reasonable)।

question: The heavy rain will only ________ the existing traffic problems in the city.
solution: Add to का अर्थ है 'किसी चीज़ को बढ़ाना' (increase something)। बारिश ट्रैफिक की समस्या को और बढ़ा देगी।

question: The nurse was hired to ________ the elderly patient day and night.
solution: Attend on/upon का अर्थ है 'किसी की सेवा करना' (to serve/wait upon)।

question: The corrupt politician tried to ________ the journalist to hide the truth.
solution: Buy off का अर्थ है 'रिश्वत देकर चुप कराना' (bribe someone to stop trouble)।

question: You should ________ your past successes to achieve even more in the future.
solution: Build on का अर्थ है 'आधार बनाकर आगे बढ़ना' (use as a foundation for progress)।

question: After the shipwreck, the survivors were ________ on a deserted island.
solution: Cast away का अर्थ है 'जहाज डूबने के बाद किसी तट पर फंस जाना' (stranded after a shipwreck)।

question: He is trying to ________ to the new boss to get a promotion.
solution: Cozy up का अर्थ है 'चापलूसी करना या बहुत करीब होने की कोशिश करना'। इसके अलावा 'आराम से बैठना' भी इसका अर्थ है।

question: The magician’s trick ________ the entire audience ________.
solution: Blow away का अर्थ है 'बहुत अधिक प्रभावित करना' (greatly impress someone)।

question: You should ________ the contract carefully before signing it.
solution: Check through का अर्थ है 'किसी चीज़ को अच्छी तरह से जाँचना' (to examine thoroughly)।

question: The detective is trying to ________ what really happened that night.
options: Call out (Note: Logic dictates 'Account for' or 'Call up') (सही Phrasal verb सूची से: Call up)
solution: Call up का एक अर्थ 'पुरानी यादों या सूचनाओं को दिमाग में लाना' भी होता है (to bring to mind)।

question: During the boss's absence, the assistant manager will ________ the head of the department.
solution: Act as का अर्थ है 'किसी भूमिका को निभाना' (perform the role)। 'Act for' का अर्थ प्रतिनिधि होना होता है, पर भूमिका निभाने के लिए 'Act as' सटीक है।

question: If you can't finish the task, you should ________ me ________.
solution: Count out का अर्थ है 'बाहर रखना या शामिल न करना' (to exclude someone)。

question: On my way home, I might ________ the library to return these books.
solution: Call by का अर्थ है 'कहीं थोड़ी देर के लिए रुकना या मिलना' (visit briefly)।

question: She worked hard to ________ a career as a successful doctor.
solution: Carve out का अर्थ है 'कड़ी मेहनत से अपनी जगह या करियर बनाना' (create through effort)।

question: The company is going to ________ to a new digital accounting system next month.
solution: Change over का अर्थ है 'एक प्रणाली या तरीके से दूसरे पर जाना' (to switch from one system to another)।

question: If you keep working 16 hours a day, you will eventually ________.
solution: Burn out का अर्थ है 'अत्यधिक काम से थककर चूर हो जाना' (become exhausted from overwork)।

question: The milk started to ________ because she forgot to turn off the stove.
solution: Boil over का अर्थ है 'उबलकर बर्तन से बाहर आना' (overflow while boiling)।

question: If you don't study hard, you ________ a big disappointment on result day.
solution: Be in for का अर्थ है 'किसी अप्रिय अनुभव का सामना करने वाला होना' (about to experience something unpleasant)।

question: Before leaving the shore, the sailors had to ________ the ropes of the small boat.
solution: Cast off का अर्थ है 'नाव को खोलना' (to untie a boat)। 'Cast out' का अर्थ निकाल देना होता है।

question: I have to ________ at the office at 9:00 AM every morning.
solution: Clock in का अर्थ है 'काम पर आने का समय दर्ज करना'।

question: Stress and lack of sleep can ________ a severe headache.
solution: Bring on का अर्थ है 'किसी चीज़ का कारण बनना या उसे शुरू करना' (cause or trigger)।

question: I am ________ your support to win this election.
solution: Bank on का अर्थ है 'किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति पर भरोसा करना' (to rely/depend on)।

question: I thought he was my friend, but he ________ me when I needed him most.
solution: Bail on का अर्थ है 'मुसीबत में किसी को बीच में छोड़ देना' (abandon someone/break commitment)।

question: The crowd began to ________ the marathon runners as they approached the finish line.
solution: Cheer on का अर्थ है 'चिल्लाकर किसी का उत्साहवर्धन करना' (to encourage with shouts)।

question: He ________ his entire inheritance in just two years.
solution: Burn through का अर्थ है 'पैसे या संसाधन को बहुत जल्दी खर्च कर देना' (use up something quickly)।

question: She is so smart that she ________ the difficult entrance exam.
solution: Breeze through का अर्थ है 'किसी काम को बहुत आसानी से पूरा कर लेना' (accomplish easily)।

question: The old abandoned warehouse ________ last night due to a short circuit.
solution: Burn down का अर्थ है 'पूरी तरह जलकर राख हो जाना' (destroy completely by fire)।

question: Many young men were ________ to serve in the army during the war.
solution: Call up का अर्थ है 'सैन्य सेवा के लिए बुलाना' (summon for military service)। इसका एक अर्थ फोन करना भी होता है।

question: The doctor advised the patient to ________ the new information regarding his health.
solution: Act on/upon का अर्थ है 'सलाह या सूचना पर अमल करना' (take action based on advice)।

question: Please ________ the customer's complaints immediately.
solution: Attend to का अर्थ है 'किसी मामले को निपटाना या ध्यान देना' (to deal with something)।

question: They decided to ________ the baby ________ his grandfather.
solution: Call after का अर्थ है 'किसी के नाम पर नाम रखना' (name someone after another)।

question: The government has to ________ spending to reduce the national deficit.
solution: Cut back का अर्थ है 'कटौती करना या खर्च कम करना' (to reduce expenditure)。

question: It was a very risky mission, but the team managed to ________ it ________ successfully.
solution: Bring off का अर्थ है 'किसी मुश्किल काम को सफलतापूर्वक पूरा करना' (succeed in doing something difficult)।

question: The military coup was intended to ________ the corrupt government.
solution: Bring down का अर्थ है 'सत्ता से हटाना या गिराना' (to overthrow/cause to fall)।

question: The caterpillar will eventually ________ a beautiful butterfly.
solution: Change into का अर्थ है 'पूरी तरह बदल जाना या रूपांतरित होना' (to transform)।

question: Please ________ and tell me exactly what happened.
solution: Calm down का अर्थ है 'शांत होना' (become less agitated)।

question: After the long hike, I ________ as soon as I hit the bed.
solution: Crash out का अर्थ है 'थकान के कारण तुरंत सो जाना' (to fall asleep quickly from exhaustion)。

question: I don't ________ the theory that money can buy happiness.
solution: Buy into का अर्थ है 'किसी विचार या सिद्धांत में विश्वास करना' (to believe in an idea)।

question: I brought some flowers to ________ her ________ after her surgery.
solution: Cheer up का अर्थ है 'खुश होना या किसी को खुश करना' (to become or make happier)।
